name: Mother Morel
win: “The forest thanks you. It will not say so; it is a forest. The Psychic Badge is yours.”
hint: Mother Morel’s Psychic team is level 46–48. Steel and Dragon Billies shrug off Psychic moves.

script: [happy] The forest remembers every spore. The Variants are grinding up its memory to make a record shine. #l:8946
